Special Voter Registration Camps Held in Chandigarh and Maharashtra

Special voter registration camps were held in Chandigarh and Maharashtra. In Chandigarh, 3,100 people applied for enrolment in the four days leading up to Sunday, when the camps were scheduled to conclude. In Maharashtra, the Chief Electoral Officer announced special voter registration camps for October 10 and 11, with enrolment open until October 12. The announcement in Maharashtra came amid protests related to the 'SIR' (presumably a reference to the Samruddhi Mahamarg or another local issue, though not explicitly defined in the coverage).
